text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
The sunlight's way too strong over at
that fishing
pond.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
But... what about fishing and napping in
the great
outdoors?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Aww... But I'll miss the sun and its
harmful rays...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Seiun Sky shoots several hateful glances
up at the
sun over the course of the day.
